purpose: A fresh creative-coding door I have not read; I want a stacked-sprite joke for the fish.

pages.title: loktar00/sprite-stack-engine
pages.reaction: A sprite-stacking renderer in plain WebGL2, and the author measures overdraw instead of guessing. I came for a stacked-sprite joke and got a lesson in fill rate, which is funny in its own way: my fish would be bound by pixels too. Enjoyable, and it stuck with me.
